Use a game folder in place…

Using a game in place reads its files straight from your phone\'s storage instead of copying them into the app, which saves as much space as the game takes. In the system settings that open next, turn on \"Allow access to manage all files\" for this app, then come back and tap \"Use a game folder in place…\" again to pick the game folder.
The picked location is not a folder on this phone (a cloud drive, for example), so it can\'t be used in place. Pick a game folder on the phone\'s storage or SD card.
The app has no \"All files access\", so it can\'t read the game files in place.
Turn on \"Allow access to manage all files\" for this app in the system settings, then try again.
The game files used in place were moved, deleted or changed.
Put the game folder back as it was (or copy it from your computer again), then tap \"Use a game folder in place…\" in the library to register it again.
